notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.notes:
In this update, several issues have been fixed, the visual aspect of several levels has been improved, the game has been optimized for better performance running at 60 fps stable.

notes.title: Patch/Parches
notes.notes:
The level of the forest has been modified as it was confusing for the players, has been added floor under the elevator (when it was elevated you could see the void underneath) some invisible walls have been added in an area so that the player does not fall. a greeting, Blue Comands

Se ha modificado el nivel del bosque ya que era confuso para los jugadores, se ha añadido suelo debajo del ascensor(cuando se elevaba podías ver el vacío debajo) se han añadido algunas paredes invisibles en una zona para que el jugador no se caiga. un saludo, Blue Comands
